note: Return-game constants. Volume is driven by the opponent: they punt when they stall (punt returns) and kick off when they score (kick returns). The two cancel, so a matchup moves the MIX not the total — which matters only because a punt return scores far more often. Kick numbers are 2025-only: the dynamic-kickoff change took the return rate from 33% to 74.5%, so earlier seasons describe a different game.
